Subject: AuricleTech onboarding: PO requirement and invoice question

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the product demo last week — excited to get AuricleTech set up. Two quick procurement questions before we start the pilot billing:

1) Does Redwood require a purchase order for small pilots? Our standard is invoicing net 30; we don't usually issue a PO until a contract is signed.
2) If a PO is required, is there an interim path (invoice-only) you can use while contract signing is in progress?

I've attached our vendor intake PDF and a draft SOW for the pilot. Happy to jump on a call if that helps.

Best,

Hi Sara —

Thanks for sending these over and for the demo follow-up. Short answers: we prefer vendor-issued POs for any recurring or pilot spend where possible, but procurement can approve a temporary invoice-only path for first-time, low-risk pilots.

I'm looping in Marissa from Procurement and Ben from Sales to confirm the guardrails. Can you confirm: estimated pilot spend, desired start date, and whether AuricleTech can supply a W-9 and bank remit details? That will speed review.

Next steps: Marissa, can you review AuricleTech's intake and advise on a temporary invoice route (threshold, evidence required)? Ben — flag if this needs sales terms locked before finance sign-off.

Laura Bennett

laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Apr 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AuricleTech onboarding: PO requirement and invoice question

Laura / Sara —

Reviewed the intake. Procurement policy requires POs for vendor relationships that will exceed $5k in a 30-day window. For first-time pilots under that threshold we can offer a controlled invoice-only onboarding under the following conditions:

- Pilot capped at $8,000 total for first 60 days.
- AuricleTech provides completed vendor intake, W-9, and bank remit confirmation (ACH details).
- Redacted SOW acceptable for initial approval; final SOW must be uploaded before month 2.
- We will not set up recurring auto-pay without PO; payments processed via AP upon invoice submission (net 30).
- Procurement will issue a temporary vendor ID and flag the account for PO requirement after the pilot.

I attached the procurement checklist and a short evidence template. If AuricleTech agrees, procurement will provision the invoice-only path and note the spend cap. Any exceptions to the cap require a finance approval ticket.

Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
